headline: Amit Dalmia files SEBI Regulation 31(4) disclosure of substantial acquisition in R&B Denims Limited
sum: Amit Dalmia has filed a mandatory disclosure under SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011, Regulation 31(4), signalling a material shareholding development in listed denim manufacturer R&B Denims Limited, triggering open offer or concert-party disclosure obligations.
detail: Amit Dalmia has submitted a formal disclosure under Regulation 31(4) of the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011 to the National Stock Exchange (NSE). This regulation mandates disclosure when an acquirer breaches the 25% shareholding threshold or when concert-party relationships materially affect voting control. R&B Denims Limited is a publicly listed textile company. The disclosure filing on the NSE archives indicates either an ongoing acquisition process or completion of a substantial stake increase, but the specific shareholding percentage, transaction value, and deal structure remain to be disclosed in follow-up filings or open offer documents.
